mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_USER WHERE USER_NUM = #{userNum} AND USER_TYPE = 'ADMIN'

SELECT R.REPORT_NUM as reportNum, R.REPORTER_NUM as reporterNum, R.TARGET_TYPE as targetType, R.TARGET_NUM as targetNum, R.REPORT_REASON as reportReason, R.REPORT_STATUS as reportStatus FROM T_REPORT R WHERE R.REPORT_NUM = #{reportNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_POST SET POST_TITLE = '관리자에 의해 블라인드 처리된 게시물입니다.', POST_CONTENT = '신고 누적으로 인하여 관리자에 의해 삭제(블라인드) 조치되었습니다.', POST_FILE = NULL WHERE POST_NUM = #{postNum}
UPDATE T_COMMENT SET COMMENT_CONTENT = '관리자에 의해 블라인드 처리된 댓글입니다.', IS_DELETED = 1 WHERE COMMENT_NUM = #{commentNum}
